title: Weather
description: Current weather conditions and meteorological data for a specific location including temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, visibility, UV index, and weather conditions. Used for weather applications, forecasting services, and climate monitoring.

id.description: Unique identifier for the weather record

city.description: Name of the city where weather was observed

country.description: Name of the country where weather was observed

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the weather observation location

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the weather observation location

temperature.description: Current air temperature in degrees Celsius

feels_like.description: Apparent or 'feels like' temperature in degrees Celsius, accounting for wind and humidity

pressure.description: Atmospheric pressure in hectopascals (hPa) or millibars

wind_speed.description: Wind speed in meters per second

wind_direction.description: Wind direction (e.g., N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) or degrees (0-360)

condition.description: Current weather condition (e.g., clear, cloudy, rain, snow, fog, storm)

description.description: Detailed textual description of current weather conditions

uv_index.description: Ultraviolet (UV) index value (0-11+), indicating sunburn risk

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the weather observation was recorded
